urlText: Sydney Olympic Park diversions for a special event
content:
From 1.30am to 1.30pm on Sunday 18 May, Route 525 and Route 526 services will be diverting while roads are closed in Sydney Olympic Park for the Sydney 10 event by Athletics NSW. 
 
Services in both directions will be diverting via Edwin Flack Avenue, Sarah Durack Avenue and Australia Avenue, and will miss stops on Dawn Fraser Avenue and Park Street. Catch these services from the stop on Park Street at Olympic Park train station or other alternative stop locations on Edwin Flack Avenue.
 
Allow extra time and check signs at stops for alternative stop locations.
 
Closed stops:
  • Park Street opposite Olympic Park Station, Sydney Olympic Park (212790)
    Alternative stop: Olympic Park Station, Park Street, Sydney Olympic Park (212712)
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue opposite Olympic Park Station, Sydney Olympic Park (212791)
    Alternative stop: Olympic Park Station, Park Street, Sydney Olympic Park (212712)
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue before Edwin Flack Avenue, Sydney Olympic Park (212788)
    Alternative stop: Edwin Flack Avenue opposite Accor Stadium, Sydney Olympic Park (212735)
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue after Edwin Flack Avenue, Sydney Olympic Park (212787)
    Alternative stop for Route 526 only: Sydney Olympic Park Athletic Centre, Edwin Flack Avenue, Sydney Olympic Park (212733)
    Alternative stop for Route 525 only: Accor Stadium, Edwin Flack Avenue, Sydney Olympic Park (212736)
  • Olympic Park Station, Dawn Fraser Avenue, Sydney Olympic Park (212792)
    Alternative stop: Olympic Park Station, Park Street, Sydney Olympic Park (212712)
